sources.entry: Drop - Game distribution platform, designed for distributing and sharing DRM-free games efficiently (alternative to Steam, GameVault). (Source Code, Clients) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Drop is an open-source platform for distributing and sharing DRM-free games, similar to GameVault or Steam.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Drop as a game distribution platform for sharing DRM-free games quickly. It states that an instance is never accessible without authentication and that it supports many authentication mechanisms, from username/password to SSO. The README stresses a clean, simple user interface with advanced features available for users who want them. Deployment is covered in separate documentation, and the README points to a contributing guide that covers project setup, code contributions, issue reporting, and translation. The README gives no further detail on specific features.
use_cases: share games with friends or a group
how_to_run: See the project's deployment documentation (linked from the README; no commands given in the README itself)
notable: Authentication-first design: an instance is never reachable without authentication
Supports many auth mechanisms, including username/password and SSO
Clean, simple user interface with optional advanced features
Has a translation process documented in the contributing guide
caveats: Maintenance mode: no new large features, only bug fixes and external contributions merged
README gives no install commands; deployment details are in external documentation
